records.Name: Cherrywood
records.geography_status: Source location better constrained by original indexed nearby-spot distances but no original GPS

sources.finding: Irish national directory lists Cherrywood as a natural area.
Direct original detail unavailable.

CRITICAL: Search-indexed original detail text claims men walking in the area seeking hookups, marks natural area, rated high influx/privacy (self-rated and not independently verified). Related spots shown by platform: Halli Sauna 0.4km, Loughlinstown Woods 0.9km, abandoned warehouse 1.1km, Cabinteely Park 1.8km. Original GPS link still unavailable. Check-in counters (115 total; 4 last month in cached indexed page) are relative/unanchored and do not prove a dated 2026 visit.
Cherrywood development advertises 150 acres public parkland and substantial redevelopment, so historical open-space/access descriptions may have changed.
Developer names new Tully, Ticknick and Beckett public parks; no evidence the historic source refers to any particular one.
Loughlinstown Woods independent map location 53.2443,-6.1280; source says Cherrywood spot 0.9km from here, a spatial clue only, not the Cherrywood source pin.

records.description: An archived cruising directory describes a natural area at Cherrywood with people walking there to meet men. The indexed original listing narrows it to within about 0.9 km of Loughlinstown Woods and 0.4 km of a nearby venue called Halli Sauna, rather than anywhere across the wider Cherrywood district. The site has changed considerably as new parks and housing were developed, and the original map pin is not accessible; relative check-in totals are not dated proof of recent encounters.
outstanding: Recover original 35604 walking-directions destination to identify exact historic area
Confirm locations of nearby same-platform 'Halli Sauna' and abandoned warehouse; do not merge with nearby Loughlinstown Woods
Investigate redeveloped landscape and dated reports

records.Name: BSQ toilets
records.geography_status: Beacon South Quarter abbreviation confirmed geographically; specific toilet not located

sources.finding: Original directory includes BSQ toilets as Dublin candidate.
Source-level interior restroom and map unavailable.

BSQ is Beacon South Quarter, Sandyford Dublin 18. Official site describes multiple separate retail, apartment and office structures, central Courtyard/Plaza, Dunnes Stores two floors and underground parking. No particular public toilet identified.
Another source listing places BSQ toilets approximately 4.2 km away from Seapoint; spatial cross-check only, not source pin.
Previous broad source-coordinate 53.27823,-6.21561 is Beacon South Quarter landmark, not indoor toilet GPS.

records.description: BSQ toilets is an archived cruising lead associated with Beacon South Quarter, a large mixed-use retail and residential complex in Sandyford, Dublin 18. The development's name is independently confirmed, but the complex includes several buildings, shops, courtyard spaces and parking, and no particular accessible toilet is established in the sources checked. The original spot page is unavailable and current cruising activity remains unverified.
